up: Find all molecules that have bioactivity data recorded in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5291702. Return distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and preferred names.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5291702' ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
